jobs_results.title: Frontend Developer (Angular) - Empresa internacional - AI/ML
jobs_results.description:
• Frontend Developer (Angular 15) - Empresa internacional - AI/ML|Procucto SaaS que permite la gestión íntegra e inteligente de archivos en cloud.

About Our Client

Nuestro cliente es una empresa internacional de origen europeo. Su función se basa en crear y mejorar un producto SaaS enfocado a la gestión integra y eficiente de cualquier tipo de documento de forma digital y a través del Cloud.

El producto esta hecho en Python, Java, Angular y AWS, su arquitectura se basa en microservicios y microfrontends y además de ello incorpora componentes de AI y ML para hacer todavía más completas sus funcionalidades.

El equipo está formado por 20 personas, amantes del gaming y los side-projects.

Job Description
• Toma requerimientos y tradúcelos en soluciones técnicas.
• Desarrollo de nuevas funcionalidades junto a Angular en sus últimas versiones.
• Forma parte de la toma de decisiones en relación a la arquitectura Frontend (Angular).
• Coordina tu trabajo junto a otros departamentos como... Backend, Diseño, Ops y QA.
• Desarrollo de test unitarios para garantizar al máximo el Test Coverage.

The Successful Applicant
• Al menos 2-3 años de experiencia como Frontend developer.
• Al menos 2 años de experiencia junto a Angular.
• Experiencia junto a otros frameworks será valorada positivamente pero no necesaria.
• Buen conocimiento de Typescript.
• Experiencia realizando Unit testing o con herramientas similares a Karma y Jasmine y Jest.
• Inglés: intermedio.

What's on Offer
• Modelo Híbrido (3 días oficina 2 en casa).
• Budget salarial: 40K-50K.
• Cada viernes se da permiso para realizar side-projects con su posterior presentación de MVP y seguimiento de proyecto.
• Acceso a formaciones.
• Campeonatos de Gaming.
• Afterwork a las 17:00h.
• Revisiones salariales anuales.

Contact: Pierre Rivenc

Quote job ref: JN-102023-6218817

jobs_results.title: Front-End Developer
jobs_results.description:
We're looking for a Front-End Developer with more than 4 years of experience in application development with React. The ideal candidate would have experience building and deploying modern web applications.

Candidates must have familiarity with the Software Development life cycle and be able to employ best practices such as TDD, Software Version Control (Git/GitHub) in an Agile environment.

Here's our app development stack:
• Frontend: React / TypeScript
• Backend: FastAPI / SQLAlchemy / postgreSQL / Snowflake / Elasticsearch
• Platform: AWS / GitHub / Docker / ECS / GitHub Actions / Sentry / AuthO

Responsibilities:
• Build the front-end of data-centric web applications, including the development and maintenance of generic reusable Ul components
• Working with UX, Back-end Developers, Data Engineering and the Product team to design and deliver efficient code which implement business requirements to specification
• Participate in software architecture decisions
• Provide Application... Documentations and technologies, employing creative and strategic thinking to navigate challenges and capitalize on opportunities.

Qualifications:
• 4+ years of web application development experience
• Familiarity with React - Hooks - State management (we use Zustand)
• Familiarity with TypeScript
• Familiarity with GitHub
• Test-driven development in an agile environment
• Strong communication skills
• Innovative and collaborative

Other Tech:
• Semantic-Ul/Material
• HighCharts / React Charts
• Jest/Vitest
• Testing Library
• Auth0
• GitHub Actions

Edelman Data & Intelligence (DXI) is a global, multidisciplinary research, analytics and data consultancy with a distinctly human mission.

We use data and intelligence to help businesses and organizations build trusting relationships with people: making communications more authentic, engagement more exciting and connections more meaningful.

DXI brings together and integrates the necessary people-based PR, communications, social, research and exogenous data, as well as the technology infrastructure to create, collect, store and manage first-party data and identity resolution. DXI is comprised of over 350 research specialists, business scientists, data engineers, behavioral and machine-learning experts, and data strategy consultants based in 15 markets around the world.

To learn more, visit: https://www.edelmandxi.com

jobs_results.title: Frontend Developer - Angular
jobs_results.description:
Job Description

Lleva tu carrera al siguiente nivel con Amaris Consulting como Senior IOS Developer en España. Forma parte de un equipo internacional, prospera en un grupo global con una facturación de 800M€ y más de 1.000 clientes en todo el mundo, y un entorno ágil mediante. El candidato ideal deberá ser capaz de trabajar eficientemente en el entorno de desarrollo utilizando Visual Studio Code, Git, npm y Node.js. Además, se espera que tenga experiencia en la definición y ejecución de pruebas unitarias utilizando Jasmine y Karma.Únete a Amaris Consulting, donde podrás desarrollar tu potencial y marcar la diferencia dentro de la empresa.

✍️¿QUÉ NECESITARÍAS?✍️
• + 4 años de experiencia.
• Experiencia demostrable trabajando con Angular, preferiblemente en la versión 10.
• Fuerte conocimiento de TypeScript, CSS/SASS, Bootstrap y HTML5.
• Experiencia en el uso de IDE Visual Studio Code, control de versiones Git, gestión de paquetes npm y entorno de ejecución Node.js.
• Capacidad para... escribir pruebas unitarias efectivas utilizando Jasmine y Karma.
• Experiencia previa en el desarrollo de aplicaciones web responsivas y compatibles con múltiples navegadores.
• Excelentes habilidades de resolución de problemas y capacidad para trabajar de manera independiente o en equipo.

🙌Y SI ADEMÁS…🙌
• Titulación en Informática, Ingeniería de Software o campo relacionado, será una ventaja.

👉¿QUÉ VAS A HACER?👈
• Desarrollar y mantener aplicaciones web utilizando Angular 10.
• Implementar interfaces de usuario atractivas y funcionales utilizando HTML5, CSS/SASS y Bootstrap.
• Colaborar con el equipo de diseño para convertir diseños en productos digitales interactivos.
• Integrar servicios back-end con APIs RESTful.
• Escribir código limpio y modular utilizando TypeScript.
• Realizar pruebas unitarias utilizando Jasmine y Karma para garantizar la calidad del código.
• Optimizar el rendimiento de las aplicaciones para una carga rápida y una experiencia de usuario fluida.

🚀¿POR QUÉ NOSOTROS?🚀

Únete a nuestro equipo dinámico de personas talentosas y descubre un mundo lleno de crecimiento y oportunidades. Esto es lo que ofrecemos:
• Crecimiento rápido a través de un camino profesional personalizado y evaluación salarial. El 70% de nuestros líderes senior comenzaron en puestos de nivel inicial.
• Mejora tus habilidades a través de nuestro catálogo de nuestra Academia Tecnológica, la plataforma Udemy, Clases de idiomas, webinars y talleres.
• Toma el control de tu formación conun presupuesto personal anual y certificaciones pagadas por la empresa.
• Disfruta de políticas flexibles, opciones de trabajo remoto y excelentes beneficios socialescomo boletos de transporte y restaurantes, apoyo para guardería y seguro de salud privado.
• Benefíciate denuestro programa WeCare, que brindaapoyo a los empleados en situaciones críticas.
• Libera todo tu potencial, tanto profesional como personal.

Amaris Consulting se enorgullece de ser un lugar de trabajo con igualdad de oportunidades. Nos comprometemos a promover la diversidad dentro de la plantilla y a crear un entorno de trabajo inclusivo. Para ello, damos la bienvenida a las solicitudes de todos los candidatos cualificados, independientemente de su género, orientación sexual, raza, etnia, creencias, edad, estado civil, discapacidad u otras características

jobs_results.title: Senior Frontend Developer
jobs_results.description:
We are looking from strong background in UI Development with some exposure in IOS/Android

Base location could be Madrid, Toronto or UK.

About the Job

Engineers at BXB Digital work on next generation digital supply chain platform (IoT-enabled supply chain). As a member of a creative, motivated, and talented team, you develop new products that are used by internal and external operations team. We need our engineers to be versatile and passionate to take on new problems as we continue to push forward in converting the supply chain to digital supply chain. If you get excited about building new things and working across disciplines, then our team might be your next career step.

As a Mobile developer, you will play a crucial role in the creation and maintenance of mobile applications that run seamlessly on multiple platforms. You will work closely with our application and platform development teams, and our UX design team to deliver high-quality, user-friendly apps that provide an... outstanding user experience. The work is challenging, fast-paced, and always changing. You have demonstrated analytical skills, an unwavering commitment to quality, a collaborative work ethic, and cutting-edge coding skills.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience.
• 4 years of coding experience in one or more of the listed languages: Java/Kotlin, Objective C/Swift, JavaScript, Typescript, CSS, HTML
• Experience with JavaScript frameworks (Angular or React) and CSS pre-processing frameworks (Sass or Less).
• Proven experience in mobile app development, specifically using Cordova.
• Understanding of cross-platform development challenges and solutions.
• Experience with version control systems, particularly Git.
• Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills.
• Strong communication and teamwork skills.
• Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects.

Responsibilities
• App Development: Design, develop, test, and maintain hybrid mobile applications using Cordova that are compatible with both Android and iOS platforms.
• Code Optimization: Optimize application performance for a smooth user experience and ensure responsiveness.
• User Interface (UI/UX): Collaborate with designers to implement intuitive and visually appealing user interfaces.
• Plugin Integration: Integrate and customize Cordova plugins to add functionality and features to the mobile apps.
• Cross-Platform Compatibility: Ensure that the apps function seamlessly on various devices and screen sizes.
• Version Control: Manage code repositories and version control systems, such as Git.
• Testing and Debugging: Perform thorough testing and debugging to identify and resolve issues.
• Performance Monitoring: Continuously monitor app performance, conduct regular assessments, and implement improvements.
• Documentation: Maintain clear and comprehensive code documentation.
• Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and QA engineers, to deliver high-quality applications on time

jobs_results.title: Frontend Developer for the Space Sector
jobs_results.description:
Do you want to face new challenges without giving up the stability of a highly experienced technology group? At GMV…

We are expanding our teams in the space sector to take on projects within the areas of Space Surveillance and Tracking and Space Traffic Management.

We´ll get to the point; we'll tell you what's not on the web. If you want to know more about us go to GMV website

WHAT CHALLENGE WILL YOU BE TAKING ON?

In our team, you will be integrated into a multidisciplinary team of Space Surveillance and Tracking (SST) and Space Traffic Management (STM) at GMV, located in several countries, with various ongoing projects.

Space Traffic Management is becoming an increasingly relevant topic due to the need to manage the traffic of objects orbiting the Earth, whether space debris or operational satellites, which are currently growing and expected to increase further due to the launch of mega-constellations.

The main responsibilities will include:
• Design and implementation of the... web User Interface of a System to monitor space debris
• UX/UI Design
• Develop reusable UI components
• Collaborate with others in a geographically distributed team.

WHAT DO WE NEED IN OUR TEAM?

For this position, we are seeking software engineers or similar with education and interest in frontend development.

We will also consider prior experience and knowledge in:
• React
• Typescript
• CSS
• REST API
• JavaScript 3D library
• Linux
• Docker
• Spring Boot

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

🕑 Hybrid working model and 8 weeks per year of teleworking outside your usual geographical area.

💻 Flexible start and finish times, and intensive working hours Fridays and in summer.

🚀 Personalized career plan development, training and language learning support.

🌍 National and international mobility. Do you come from another country? We can offer you a relocation package.

jobs_results.title: Front End Engineer
jobs_results.description:
WhereTo is a business travel startup from San Francisco that evolved into an agile development and design studio within the Flight Centre Travel Group. We build travel solutions used by some of the largest companies on the planet - we have just one goal: making business travel better for everybody.

WhereTo provides an AI-powered travel platform for corporate travel. Their platform uses machine learning algorithms to recommend personalized travel options based on a traveler's preferences, company policies, and budget. WhereTo's technology also allows for real-time travel tracking, reporting, and cost analysis, enabling companies to optimize their travel programs and reduce costs.

To learn more about WhereTo click HERE

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a passionate, motivated and skilled Senior Front End Engineer to join our growing engineering team within the Lab in Barcelona. This is an exciting opportunity to be an integral part of the team leading the return totravel. We... are looking for a self-motivated team player, a mentor to others contributing to our culture of engineering and operational excellence, continuously improving our craftsmanship.

Key Responsibilities
• Responsible for building components for the user interface (UI); utilizing various JavaScript libraries and tools such as React.js, Redux, and Node.js/npm.
• Leading and helping the Front-End team code with performance, scalability, and usability in mind.
• You will live and breathe the virtual-DOM, pure reducers and immutable data structures.

Experience & Qualifications
• 4+ years professional software development experience (internships and personal projects not included)
• 2+ years experience with React.js or other web framework (Vue.js, Angular, Ember, etc.)
• Experience with state containers (i.e Redux, Alt, Flux)
• Experience with modern JavaScript (ES6, Babel, FlowType and/or TypeScript, Webpack)
• HTML5 (specifically dealing with IE quirks)
• JavaScript testing experience (Mocha, Jasmine and Jest)
• Experienced in Agile development and TDD / BDD
• Able to iterate quickly
• Strong understanding of Git fundamentals
• Experience with pure-functional programming is a bonus (Ramda, Lo-Dash FP, etc)
• Interest in full-stack development is a bonus.

Benefits

As well as being a fun company to work :
• An attractive package: health insurance
• 25 days off/year + 5 compensation days + reduced time during summer + bank holidays
• Flexible working-time
• Our fantastic offices are located in the heart of Barcelona, at Plaça Catalunya
• The opportunity to join our free language lessons (English, French, Spanish or Catalan)
• Table tennis on the terrace, a kitchen area with free snacks, fresh fruits and drinks
• The opportunity to work with an international and talented team
• Several activities organised by the ambassadors!

We truly think your personality is important, so bring it on

jobs_results.description:
Description

Why YOU want this position

Enverus has expanded its solutions in Power & Renewables with the addition of RatedPower. A high growth start up, RatedPower’s technology expands our portfolio of solutions in solar with its cloud-based software that automates and optimizes the feasibility study, analysis, design and engineering of solar power plants, and our geographical coverage internationally.

Enverus is the leading energy SaaS company delivering highly technical insights and predictive/prescriptive analytics that empower customers to make decisions that increase profit. Enverus’ innovative technologies drive production and investment strategies, enable best practices for energy and commodity trading and risk management, and reduce costs through automated processes across critical business functions. Enverus is a strategic partner to more than 6,000 customers in 50 countries.

We are currently seeking a Frontend React Developer to join our Engineering team based in Madrid... This role offers the opportunity to join a rapidly growing company delivering industry-leading solutions to customers in the world’s most dynamic and fastest-growing sector. 

What Will You Do
• Improve pvDesign by developing new or improving functionalities, with efficient, reusable, and easy to maintain code
• Collaborate with Product, Design and Backend teams, to frame and tackle the challenges, both from a technical and business context.
• Identify and implement improvements that reduce technical debt and enable the team to iterate faster.

What You Should Have
• 2+ year in frontend development
• Solid knowledge of JavaScript, Web & Browser concepts
• 2+ year with React
• State management libraries (Redux, Zustand, etc.)
• Previous experience writing automated tests.
• Strong motivation to drive impact by making product improvements.
• Proactiveness, team player and willingness to teach & learn from peers.

Our Tech Stack
• ReactJS
• Typescript
• CSS-in-JS with Styled Components
• Figma for prototype design
• Testing with Jest & Cypress,
• API GraphQL with Apollo Client
• GitHub
• Travis
• AWS with S3 and CloudFront
